summary: Learn to assess competitors, select target segments and build evidence-backed positioning. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: Positioning and differentiation in competitive markets helps product, marketing and commercial teams choose and explain a distinct offer for a target market. The course covers market boundaries, STP segment selection and perceptual mapping, helping you compare alternatives, assess buyer priorities and build an evidence-based value proposition with credible proof points. You will also draft channel-ready positioning claims and use scorecards and market-test plans to communicate choices, assumptions and next steps.
audienceIntro: This course suits you if your role requires choosing, testing or communicating how a product or service stands apart in a defined market. It is designed for professionals who can bring a product, customer group or market example into the exercises.
modules: Porter's Five Forces and Market Boundaries
Jobs to Be Done and Alternatives
prerequisites: Bring a basic working understanding of a product, service or market relevant to your role. No coding is required; familiarity with spreadsheets is useful for segment scoring and comparison exercises.
